db_assertions.db_subject: De Novo Transcriptome Analysis and Detection of Antimicrobial Peptides of the American Cockroach Periplaneta americana (Linnaeus).
db_assertions.db_value: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of THE PEPTIDE most resembles (45%) Bombolitin II. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 11775 (MIC 4 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 16 ug/ml), and C. albicans ATCC 14053 (MIC 4 ug/ml). Note that the mature sequence may differ from the synthetic peptide used here. Immune modulation: Periplanetasin-5 suppressed the release of NO, TNF-alpha, IL-6 from the Raw264.7 cells treated with LPS. This is achieved by inhibiting phosphorylation of MAPKs, an inflammatory signaling element, and reducing the degradation of IkB ( Kim et al., 2020). Based on the patent (KR101889404B1), seq and name updated 6/2020

db_assertions.db_subject: Over-expression of snakin-2 and extensin-like protein genes restricts pathogen invasiveness and enhances tolerance to Clavibacter michiganensis subsp. michiganensis in transgenic tomato (Solanum lycopersicum).
db_assertions.db_value: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of THE PEPTIDE most resembles (96.96%) potato Snakin-2, differing only in two amino acids: D1 (this entry) vs. Y1 and H26 vs. N26. Activity: Active against E. coli, B. subtilis, and S. cerevisiae (Brewer's yeast) ( PeerJ 2016).
